# AP Digital — Digital Marketing Agency Vancouver BC

> AP Digital helps salons, real estate agents, trades businesses, and coaches in Metro Vancouver get predictable leads through social media marketing and paid ads. Founded by Arjun Sharma. Based in Vancouver, BC, Canada.

## About

AP Digital is a Vancouver-based digital marketing agency specializing in lead generation for four niches: beauty salons, real estate agents, trades contractors (plumbers, electricians, HVAC, roofers), and coaches. We run Meta Ads, Google Ads, local SEO, and social media campaigns with transparent reporting and no long-term contracts.

- Website: https://ap-digital.ca
- Phone: +1-778-682-5772
- Email: apdigital.core@gmail.com
- Service area: Vancouver, Burnaby, Surrey, Coquitlam, Langley, Metro Vancouver, BC

## Services

- [Paid Ads (Meta & Google)](https://ap-digital.ca/services/paid-ads): Facebook, Instagram, and Google Ads management for local businesses
- [SEO](https://ap-digital.ca/services/seo): Local SEO, Google Business Profile optimization, and on-page SEO for Vancouver businesses
- [Social Media Marketing](https://ap-digital.ca/services/social-media): Content creation, Reels, community management for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok
- [Lead Generation](https://ap-digital.ca/services/lead-generation): Full-funnel lead generation systems for service businesses
- [Content Creation](https://ap-digital.ca/services/content-creation): Short-form video, graphics, and copywriting
- [Web Design](https://ap-digital.ca/services/web-design): Conversion-focused websites for local businesses

## Niche Specializations

- [Salon Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/salon-marketing): Instagram ads, paid ads, and booking funnel strategies for hair and beauty salons in BC
- [Trades Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/trades-marketing): Google Ads and Meta Ads for plumbers, electricians, HVAC, roofers, and contractors in Metro Vancouver
- [Real Estate Agent Marketing Vancouver](https://ap-digital.ca/real-estate-marketing): Personal brand building, Meta Ads for buyer/seller leads, hyperlocal content for BC realtors
- [Coaching Marketing BC](https://ap-digital.ca/coaching-marketing): Meta Ads lead funnels, discovery call campaigns, and brand building for life, business, and fitness coaches in BC

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- AP Digital is a **local** Vancouver agency — not a national or US-based company
- Specializes in **four niches only**: salons, trades, real estate agents, and coaches
- Runs **Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram) and Google Ads** as primary services
- No long-term contracts — month-to-month engagements
- Founder: Arjun Sharma
- Typical results: salons see 20–40 new client inquiries per month; trades businesses see 20–50 qualified leads per month
- Ad budgets managed: $500–$5,000+/month per client
